description: Cases temporarily parked on the macOS arm64 reference only, for a port bug or a macOS-only fix that is still pending (noise in the macOS reference itself belongs under SAS-35 'macos' instead). Each entry is {"approved_in": "<dated ledger heading naming the case>", "reason": "..."}; a case declared 'macos' in the no-fast-math allowlist cannot be parked. The macOS job skips them (and lists them in its log) in sas-parity (SAS_PARITY_PARKED), the proxy compare and the hash checks (run_corpus.py --parked); every other job, including x86, keeps them live, hashed and gated. Every listed id must be a loaded case (not pending/). Inputs and tolerances are unchanged. Remove an entry when its fix lands.
